name: DEXTROMETHORPHAN 10 MG/ PARACETAMOL 250 MG/ BROMPHENYRAMINE 2 MG/ PHENYLEPHHRINE 5 MG 12 CAPSULES
description: This combination of active ingredients, including 10 mg of dextromethorphan, 250 mg of paracetamol, 2 mg of brompheniramine, and 5 mg of phenylephrine in 12 capsules, is a medication for the symptomatic treatment of colds and flu. It relieves symptoms such as fever, headache, nasal congestion and runny nose, and dry cough. Flu and flu relief that combats the discomfort of the flu. If symptoms persist, consult your doctor.
